scope:
Read default-capture native/renderer partition inputs and session bindings.

Exports only public origins, fixed route-family labels, NetLog source/event
indices, field presence and within-capture equality labels. No credentials,
request/response bodies, signed targets or raw opaque partition values leave
the extractor. Different origins alone are not treated as context isolation.

limits: Only four retained captures lacking explicit QUIC force/disable flags are selected; this launch fact does not establish factory-default or persisted protocol state.
Partition equality labels preserve exact original value equality within one field and capture only; opaque components and hashes are never exported.
Native streaming families and renderer Pathfinder are selected explicitly; this is not a global network/session audit.

A different logged NIK/NAK is evidence of different partition inputs, not proof of distinct CEF or URLRequestContext objects. Different origins alone prove neither shared nor isolated context ownership.
A shared session is claimed only through exact original source/stream bindings. Separate observed sessions do not by themselves prove separate pools.
H2 session creation events do not expose a network_anonymization_key in these captures; request NIK is not silently substituted for session NAK.
ALT_SVC_FOUND is attributed only through selected native-spclient or renderer request source -> controller source_dependency; advertisements, expiry and backoff policy are separate.
Original credentials, opaque IDs, bodies, arbitrary/signed targets, connection IDs, raw private command lines and unknown partition text are never exported.
No original app/profile/process, account/network operation, Dart/runtime edit or Chromium decompilation.
